messages:
erin_marketing: Urgent tiny ask for the launch appendix: can runtime deliver a "minimal bench pack" by tomorrow morning? Need: (1) ~20 sanitized payloads (short/med/long/edge), (2) one-line copyable run command for hosted + dedicated, (3) cold vs warmed p95/p99 numbers, (4) q4 vs fp delta + model hash, (5) provenance line and a gs link. @mike_runtime @olga_eng

mike_runtime: We can do that. Clarify: model tag = redwood-v2-7b:stable, seq len 512, non-stream timing for the numbers?

erin_marketing: Yes, redwood-v2-7b:stable. Non-stream numbers for slides. Include a short note that demo uses streaming.

olga_eng: We'll produce payloads.json (20 items), manifest.csv (intent, edge_flag, synthetic_flag), run_hosted.sh and run_dedicated.sh, report.csv with per-request latencies, and README.md with provenance.

sam_metrics: I'll compute 95% bootstrap CI across 3 fresh trials and add it to report.csv. Need raw latencies (anonymized) to do that.

mike_runtime: Will include per-request anonymized latencies. Example hosted command we'll put in README for copy/paste:

REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 3

upload-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/minipacks/2125000000/minipack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, report.csv, README.md)

erin_marketing: Thanks — we'll review and flag if legal wants different wording. Please mark any payloads that were sanitized in the manifest so legal can check.

olga_eng: Done. Manifest flags sanitized prompts. If you need a different mix, tell us and we can swap quickly.

erin_marketing: Great. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :rocket:
